skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — extract the best moments and compile them into a 2-minute highlight reel —...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Online Highlight Editor (version 1.0.0)
- Enables users to upload videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and request AI-powered highlight extraction and export.
- Simple setup with automatic cloud connection and anonymous token provisioning (100 free credits, 7-day expiry).
- All processing and rendering handled server-side; users receive ready-to-download highlight reels in 1-2 minutes.
- Supports session-based workflows (upload, state checking, export, credit balance).
- Clear mapping of user commands to actions and robust error handling for a smooth experience.
